about_the_game:
"In the year 21XX, there is no rest for the dead—only servitude."

The world is ruled by an Emperor of unparalleled power, who commands the fate of millions in life—but also after death. He promises safety and dominion. In return, he demands absolute obedience.

You are a servitor—stripped of your name, your past, and your future. Bound by laws you did not choose, you exist as one small cog in the vast Imperial machine. There is no room for hope. No place for choice. No path but the one carved for you.

…But between a preordained future and an immovable past, something glimmers with a tantalizing light—something no one counted on you finding. An impossibly thin thread of liberation.

A path beyond the possible.

Journey Through Oblivion

MORTAL ADVOCATE is a narrative-driven 3D adventure exploring servitude, defiance, and the cost of selfhood. Navigate ash-smothered industrial ruins, asteroid mines beneath a canopy of glittering stars, and despair-soaked slums where memory, magic, and mortality intertwine. Face the might of an enormous Imperial system until despair boils over—then decide what it truly means to be free.

Features:

  • A Haunting Narrative – Uncover the hidden truths of the servitors, the Profane, the Holy, and the system that binds them all together.

  • Atmospheric Exploration – Traverse industrial ruins, asteroid mines, slums, and forgotten places where the past refuses to stay buried.

  • Philosophical Themes – Fate, identity, will, desire, and control shape your path.

  • Stylized Black & White World – A stark, high-contrast visual style where only magic dares to shine in color.

  • Immersive Sound Design – A melancholic score and ambient dread bring an undead world to life.

The past binds. The future devours. The cost of belief is everything.

content_descriptors.notes: Characters are adults: they drink, commit crimes, and engage in sex of various kinds. This game is set in a dystopia, and some characters hold power over other characters and coerce them into doing things they wouldn't ordinarily do, but this is portrayed as what it is: reprehensible and intolerable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 (4th gen or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: MORTAL ADVOCATE is a handcrafted indie game built with narrative and atmosphere in mind. While it should run smoothly on most modern systems, performance may vary depending on your hardware and background applications. We've done our best to keep things optimized, but if you're running into issues, feel free to reach out via the community hub. We're a small team (just a single fungus, really), so your understanding and support means the world. Thank you for giving this strange little story a place in your memory.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or Ryzen 5 (6th gen+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A haunting 3D adventure set in a world of servitude, decay, and forgotten futures. Will you accept your fate—or defy the inevitable?
